wh_landlord.text: Every name on these walls swam to France. Or from France: a few come the other way. We've had swimmers in their seventies, and teenagers, and a fella who did it there and back.
First thing they want when they get back? A cup of tea, and a pen.

wh_swimmer.text: Sixteen hours. Jellyfish, a ferry wake, and a seagull that followed me the whole way. My name's up there, by the fire. Spelt wrong. I don't care.
